interface.name: anchor_header_bar_manager_v1

description.summary: allow clients to request header bar area

interface.description:
This protocol allows clients to inform the compositor that they want to render their own header bar (title bar) content within the compositor's decoration area.
The client declares a desired header bar height. The compositor reserves this space above the window content area (within the SSD border region). The client's xdg_toplevel surface will be configured with a reduced height, and the client should render its header bar content (title, buttons, tabs, etc.) in the top portion of the toplevel surface.
If the compositor does not support client header bars, or the requested height is invalid, the compositor may ignore the request and the client will fall back to standard SSD decorations.

request.name: get_header_bar

description.summary: request a header bar for a toplevel

request.description:
Create a header bar object for the given xdg_toplevel surface. The client can then set the desired header bar height.
This request must be made before the first xdg_surface.configure for the toplevel. If made after, the compositor may ignore it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the header bar manager. This does not affect existing header bar objects.

interface.name: anchor_header_bar_v1
interface.description:
Represents a header bar area managed by the client. The client can set the desired height, and the compositor will adjust the window layout accordingly.
The header bar height is the space reserved above the main content area but within the window's xdg_toplevel surface. The client should render title text, window control buttons, tab bars, etc. in this area.
The compositor will still draw its SSD border around the entire window (including the header bar area), but will skip its own title/button rendering for windows that have a client header bar.

entry.name: invalid_height
entry.summary: the requested header bar height is invalid (zero or negative)

entry.name: already_set
entry.summary: the header bar height has already been committed

request.name: set_height

description.summary: set the desired header bar height

request.description:
Request a specific height (in logical pixels) for the header bar area. The compositor will configure the xdg_toplevel with a content area reduced by this height.
The client should call this once. The height cannot be changed after set_height is called.
A height of 0 means the client wants to use the full SSD decoration (no client header bar).

arg.name: height
arg.summary: header bar height in logical pixels

event.name: configured
event.description:
Sent in response to set_height. The compositor acknowledges the header bar configuration. The actual_height may differ from the requested height if the compositor has constraints.
After this event, the client knows the header bar area size and can render accordingly in the top portion of the toplevel surface.

arg.name: actual_height
arg.summary: the actual header bar height granted by the compositor

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this header bar object. The compositor will revert to standard SSD decorations for this window.
